title: Task 2 Scientific-to-Daily Learning: source-to-maturity-to-supervisor deterministic bridge falsification
question: FROZEN SINGLE RESEARCH QUESTION: Inspect exact attached original source and observed receipts. Find the minimum REAL currently missing, owner-bounded source→immutable decision/forecast→due-only outcome→baseline/adjudication→existing Framework Learning Supervisor/Strategist/S1 consumer chain that permits DAILY prospective shadow calibration and EVIDENCE-MATURED 7/14-day improvement proposals for Official Compass, while preserving all existing owners and independent science gates. This is NOT another S1 generic autonomy audit, NOT #1918 full-cycle re-entry/altseason, not another Shared Row / Cross-Domain / CRE engine, and NOT a claim that 1–2 weeks proves trading edge. First falsify whether any bridge is actually missing, identify existing code routes already doing the job, and rank MAX THREE source-backed minimal repairs (or NONE if unsupported). For each, exact existing owner/paths/function/line or precise locating instruction, specific positive and adversarial negative tests, output schema, historical/forward evidence status, 7d/14d metric with independent-family denominator and failure/abstain paths, scientific promotion gates, budget/latency and rollback. Separate daily descriptive drift alerts from minimum independent holdout promotion. Distinguish public/private/credential planes: no raw private provider values, Alpha wallets or personal holdings, even hashed low-entropy values. Confirm CRE Nov2 protocol effective-release status before granting admission, original R1 0/11 gate, 16 matched 7/16 vs B2, Scoped Task1.5 500/314/10, current W45 Cross Domain lanes, Shared Row one overlapping block, and pullback eligibility suspension. An original code diff and live consumer proof are required for closure, not a report, JSON PASS or comment. Produce a finite implementation sequence without any new scheduler/owner/queue/workflow, and a public-safe handoff that a deterministic non-API executor could implement after review. Ignore prior ChatGPT optimism; challenge it.
hypothesis: Existing mature-outcome owners and one Framework Learning Supervisor already provide most of the pieces. The highest-VOI work is at most 1–3 missing authenticated connection / eligibility / consumer readback gates, not a new model or 24-hour API research loop. Null result and no safe change are acceptable.
baseline: As-is original research and governance: Task2 #1596 historical scientific R1 0/11; CRE prospective but publication/first-known admission unresolved; Cross-Domain weekly W45 advisory Compass SOURCE_OBSERVED / AUTO source incomplete / Alpha private unavailable; Framework Learning Supervisor current science proposal NO_NEW_SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE_CHILD_TEST. Compare with no-new-code source-first waiting and with naive daily momentum / HOLD; no apparent 7/14-day skill without independent matched data.
falsifier: Demonstrate by exact current code, original scheduled run, source hashes and natural input-to-consumer receipts that the proposed gap is already closed; or show that missing private provider-first-known, actual prospective outcomes, execution-capacity proof, or original owner authority makes the suggested bridge unadmittable. A 7/14-day observation with one overlapping shock family cannot prove improvement; in that case recommend WAIT or source repair only.
kill_condition: Reject any output that creates a parallel research/Alpha/Compass engine, new scheduler, daily paid LLM scanner, automatic market weight/threshold modification, proof by synthetic fixtures alone, after-the-fact feature selection, duplicate active PR #1814/#1823 or existing #1918, trading instruction, code write, or unverified independent event count. Max THREE concrete nonoverlapping code gaps; if none, deliver supported negative result. No new paid follow-up recommendation without material external evidence.
